messages.body:
Hi Paul,

Thanks so much for coming back to me, I really appreciate it.

Just so you've got the full picture, Jake isn't a covers act in the usual sense. He doesn't copy or impersonate anyone. He's a young singer from Essex with a big natural voice, and he sings every song his own way and really hits the notes. Have you had a chance to hear him sing? There are plenty of recordings at www.jakeessex.co.uk

You could even show the site to a few of your regulars and see if they'd like to see Jake at The Stage Door. He's always local to you, so it's an easy one to set up, and he puts on an unforgettable night for everyone who comes.

If you fancy giving it a go, it's £300 cash for two 1 hour sets, or £250 a night if you book four dates. Three sets are £350, or £300 a night for four. He brings his own PA and there's no deposit.

These Saturdays are free in 2027:

January: Sat 2nd, Sat 9th
March: Sat 6th, Sat 27th
April: Sat 10th
May: Sat 22nd
June: Sat 5th
July: Sat 24th
September: Sat 11th
October: Sat 16th
November: Sat 20th
December: Sat 11th

If one works, just reply with the date and I'll get it booked in. And if it's not for you after a listen, no worries at all.

Kind regards,
Natalie
